median_age_note: Interpolated within the five-year age group that holds the middle person, from the 2006 census's count of everyone resident by five-year age group.
sex_ratio_note: Men per 1,000 women among everyone the 2006 census counted as resident here, Libyans and non-Libyans: 40,296 men and 38,267 women.
ethnicity_note: Nationality at the 2006 census: 73,443 Libyans and 5,120 residents of other nationalities.
